text: Follow-up commit bbb-fix: added 'depends on LICHEN_COAP_SERVER' to LICHEN_COAP_METRICS (reviewer pass-3 found lichen_coap_respond link failure when COAP_SERVER=n; that call site lives in coap_metrics.c:70). Identical pre-existing gap on LICHEN_COAP_LOCATION filed as its own bead.
